title: Invertible comparison counit for finite stratified models
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring, S a finite scheme stratification of X and F a pro-etale sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules. If every stratum pullback of F admits finite constant models on a pro-etale covering family, then the counit $\nu$_X^*$\nu$_{X,*}F$\to$F is an isomorphism. Use the comparison adjunction [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and finite scheme stratifications [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf].

source.place: Tags 099Y and 09AK; fixed-module coefficients and finite global stratifications

proof.text: On each stratum, [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-model-local-constancy] gives local constancy in slices and [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-finite-model-stalks] gives finite geometric stalks. The lisse-origin theorem [lem-sf-proetale-locally-constant-origin] then supplies a classical origin.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-stratified-essential-image]. Since comparison is fully faithful by [prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level], its adjunction counit is invertible precisely on its essential image (Mathlib Adjunction.isIso_counit_app_iff_mem_essImage).

lean.statement:
theorem isIso_comparison_counit_of_finite_stratification
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (S : Scheme.Stratification X)
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (hS : ∀ k : Fin S.n,
      ∃ (ι : Type (u + 1)) (W : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, W i ⟶ S.domain k),
        Presieve.ofArrows W g ∈ Scheme.proetalePrecoverage (S.domain k) ∧
          ∀ i, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ, Finite M ∧
            Nonempty (((g i)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj
              (((S.immersion k)^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ]).obj F) ≅
                (constantSheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology (W i)) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)) :
    IsIso ((comparisonAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).counit.app F)
